services.desc: At Island Surf Company, you’ll find the best rates, deals and drop-off times all year round. Beyond the boards, Island Surf Co. has always been about people. We’re proud to be an integral part of our local community-employing local talent, offering first jobs to teenagers, and helping young people build confidence, responsibility, and a lifelong connection to the ocean. Over the years, we’ve also been honoured to support community sports, grassroots events, and local initiatives that make our coastal town such a special place to live and play.
